attchmntText: Divi's Laboratories Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Divi's Laboratories Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during its Board meeting on November 07, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 3647 Crores, with a profit after tax of Rs. 1140 Crores. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 42.97. For the half year, standalone revenue was Rs. 6621 Crores, and profit after tax was Rs. 2031 Crores. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 3676 Crores. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified limited review report on the standalone financial statements. The meeting commenced at 10.30 Hrs and concluded at 11.40 Hrs.
